summary: This stage conducted an exceptionally thorough and rigorous static audit of the paper and repository without executing the notebook or downloading full embedding files. It identified crucial discrepancies, including the use of LinearSVC instead of the claimed LDA classifier (along with LDA runtime errors), extensive missing code and data assets (debiasing, alignment, word similarity, word translation, and Spearman correlation), and the grammatical agreement confound in the Table 2 word-pair translation probe. Furthermore, it demonstrated how the MWEAT dot-product implementation violates cosine similarity once vectors are shifted, traced notebook state inconsistencies, and surfaced path and prefix bugs. Calibration and provenance marking throughout the report are outstanding.
